purpose: Locate and activate the threshold text field in an underlying-symbol submit-condition row.

anchors.nameRegex: Submit when at least one of the following conditions is met

target.rowAnchor: underlying symbol, e.g. CROX or USB
target.direction: submit-side condition table, same row as symbol/method/operator
target.preferredAction: native click at table-relative threshold activation point, Ctrl+A, type threshold, Tab
target.verification: rediscover row and require the focused/editable text control or row text to contain the new threshold

thresholdClick.notes: Earlier row-center Y estimate was too low. The editable text hit was near table top + 4px. Prefer this point for initial activation, then rediscover focused text bounds.

notes: Do not use cached child indexes after expanding conditions or saving Order Rules.
Submit at must remain unchecked before saving.
TOS may report threshold editor bounds as -1 in the full table snapshot until the field is focused; use table-relative activation, then rediscover.
